description: Frozen zero-model quality-gate baselines (0.5.0 WF4 Q1). Every schema-v2 report cites this file via baseline{file,sha256,recordedAt} and scripts/check-eval-report.mjs verifies that sha against these bytes. A threshold or corpus change must update this file and eval/quality/CHANGELOG.md in the same review; re-recording a red gate to green is a contract change, not a fix.

det.notes: Golden morning hash / markdown / MCP surface live in eval/det/baseline.json; mode det carries no model-quality metric. 49 cases / 367 checks in the 0.5.0 tree (run pnpm eval:det --json for the live count).

model-contract.notes: In-process fake transport only: 12 cases, no key, no socket, no model. Stub call counts/order are asserted by eval/model-contract/run.mjs.

kb-retrieval.notes: 25 synthetic Markdown documents + 50 hand-labelled queries; lexical regression gate only (no semantic/vector claim). corpus.sha256 is the fixture-list hash (relpath\0sha256 lines).

mail-local-gold.notes: dev 90 is the L0 gate; held-out 30 is release-gate only and frozen by corpusSha256. Labels are implementer-authored synthetic, not independent human gold (unknowns.humanGold stays null).
